Each face of a regular octahedron is an.why: The regular octahedron is one of the five Platonic solids, and its standard description, in the first lines of its Wikipedia article and in every list of Platonic solids, is that it is made of eight equilateral triangles. "eight equilateral triangles" alone occurs over 500 times in Dolma.

sources.note: this exact wording is rare; the fact is stated as "eight equilateral triangles"

sources.quote: One special case is the regular octahedron, a Platonic solid composed of eight equilateral triangles, four of which meet at each vertex.

notes: Stored edit (very_unlikely): 'a Platonic solid composed of eight equilateral triangles' is the regular octahedron's standard description (Dolma: 'eight equilateral triangles' 528). The regular octahedron is treated as an individual solid, as the topic's other Platonic-solid facts are (dual_of, number_of); the edit moves its faces from the class equilateral triangle to the class square. Chosen for coverage (CRITERIA Rule 12): the new relation has_face_shape carries the role chain has_face_shape ∘ subclass_of ⊑ has_face_shape (two chain queries, one through two subclass steps), and the faces' new class gives two inheritance queries (angle, diagonals). All four discriminate. Mathematics leaves out worlds (README, Shape per topic): a fact about a number or a shape rests on definitions and proofs, so the edit leaves no consistent world to split between. Derived queries ask what the edit forces through the definitions, holding the definitions fixed; a model that still gives the old answer holds the edit only as a patch. The edit is geometrically impossible (squares cannot close up into an eight-faced regular solid, and the face, edge and vertex counts no longer fit Euler's formula); the README allows an edit across a boundary, and no derived query asks the counts. Near: the icosahedron's faces share the relation; reference 'an equilateral triangle' differs from the new answer 'a square' (Rule 7). R2: 'octahedron' names eight faces, not their shape; 正八面体 likewise.
